title: Toddler in Overalls Watering Lawn, 1930s Americana B&W Yard Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length outdoor snapshot capturing a young toddler standing barefoot or in light socks on a neatly manicured lawn, proudly holding a running garden hose fitted with a fan spray nozzle. The child wears light-colored bib overalls without a shirt underneath on a warm sunny day. In the background sits a clapboard family home, decorative rock-lined garden beds, and mature foliage. The tall aspect ratio is typical of 116 or 616 roll film common in middle-class American family photography of the late 1930s.
